payload.instruction: Make this look like a comic book photo
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image visibly use comic-book visual treatment?
node.criteria: Pass if comic-book visual treatment is visibly present; fail if it is not; unknown if the image evidence is genuinely insufficient. Treat stylistic cues as evidence, not mandatory techniques.
node.binding: Assess the edited image's overall visual treatment for the requested comic-book look. Do not count framing, tonal, or other incidental differences as comic-book styling.
